---
title: "I am waiting for feedback, approval, access, equipment or data"
last-reviewed: "2026-08-28"
---

## Name the decision and its owner

Find out where the request has reached. Sending it, receiving an acknowledgement and getting approval are different steps. Check who has the next action and when they expect to respond.

## Try this now

1. Name the required decision and its owner.
2. Record when you asked, any acknowledgement, the promised response date and the latest date that would keep your plan workable.
3. Identify work that can proceed safely.
4. Prepare a realistic fallback.
5. Follow up on the agreed date.
6. Ask for further help before the delay uses up the time you set aside for problems.

## What to take when asking

Explain when you asked, which deadline is affected, what you can do meanwhile and the alternatives. Ask for the specific decision you need.

## Stop or escalate

No response is not permission. Do not begin affected work before required approval or use informal access, credentials or storage.

## You are moving again when

You have the necessary decision, an agreed alternative or an approved change to the timetable. Keep following up until you know which applies.

Use the [risk register](../templates/risk-issues-register.qmd) and [escalation builder](../templates/escalation-message.qmd).
